label: F-01
title: Law-2 story-unsafe escalation: stories 026/027/028 model ONLY the self-sandwich; the third-party sandwicher is never considered, and the make-whole guarantee removes the victim's defensive incentive
description: The stories' accepted-extraction reasoning is 'bounded by the caller's own stake and accrued antimatter ... Human decision: accepted' -- a bound that exists ONLY for a self-sandwicher. A third party is bounded by the VICTIM's stake, which the accepting human never priced. story-028 additionally deleted the caller's minPhUSDOut knob (N32), removing the last caller-side lever. CLAUDE.md:235-236 -- 'Ordinary sandwiching of the exit is not new: a plain withdraw sells into the same AMM with the same protection' -- is materially wrong on the economics: under a plain withdraw the sandwich victim bears their own loss and therefore has a defensive incentive, whereas the make-whole top-up transfers the loss to the protocol and removes it.
impact: LAW 2. Not tallied in the H/M count. The decision record accepted an extraction bound that does not hold for the actor who matters.
severityBasis: Law-2 faithfulness item. NOT severity-bearing; must never enter the H/M tally.
recommendation: Amend the story/decision record to price the third-party sandwicher, and correct CLAUDE.md:235-236's economics claim.
citationDiscipline: The security narrative is stated ONCE, in M-01. F-01 CITES it rather than restating it. Different channel (spec-conformance.md, explicitly NOT the QA bundle), different law (Law 2 vs Law 1), different remedy (amend the story + correct CLAUDE.md vs. bound the parameter).
